reviews.title: Carplay Problems
reviews.text: Qobuz doesn’t show on CarPlay screen. Any chance of a fix? Please.

reviews.title: Can’t recognize albums, no tag editor
reviews.text: For some reason any album I have with multiple track artists shows up as several different albums with different album artist. No other music player anywhere else I’ve used has this problem. The lack of a tag editor also sucks.

reviews.title: App does not play stream to Roku like the Apple Music app does
reviews.text: I just downloaded this app to get around a problem with fake regional copyright BS. Apple is refusing to play scanned in CDs that I own and they show up as not available in my region. This app will play those songs, however they will not stream to a Roku. When I tell it to stream it looks like it is playing, and it shows the title artwork on the TV but no sound!

reviews.title: Deleting after years
reviews.text: With the free membership you used to be able to link your SoundCloud account and play your ‘lists’ through VOX at a slightly higher quality. They now charge for this feature which is lame so I’ve since deleted the app after having used it for 10+ years. Lame.

reviews.title: locked SoundCloud behind paywall and app closing after a while still happens
reviews.text: only worthwhile feature is gone, local files is just still buggy and broken and they push you to buy their also broken cloud feature which is just as bugged out as the local files are, avoid app until they improve local files and their subscription or bring back SoundCloud to free

reviews.title: re: still greedy
reviews.text: i left an extensive review of why it was actually so dumb that this company wants to paywall playing music from a DIFFERENT app they don't have any rights to in the first place, but for some reason it's gone..? anyways, my point still stands... WHY would anyone pay for this mostly broken app just to connect to soundcloud if they could just use that money to sub to soundcloud premium instead..? hey devs, make it make sense? you do not own soundcloud so why are you paywalling it hm?

reviews.title: Already dysfunctional now with more paywalls
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for ages, despite it having severe optimization problems and constant crashes just so I can utilize the SoundCloud feature
Years of dealing with unfettered garbage just for the only feature I actually enjoyed to get paywalled while the app is still broken
This isn’t going to make me pay, I am just simply going to move on to something that actually works and is free (like the actual SoundCloud app, shocker)

reviews.title: Please fix the app
reviews.text: The app is super buggy, and then one day, all my SoundCloud playlists disappeared

reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.text: Guys from Ukraine, you’ve become greedy. I’m trying to log into my account to unlock the radio I purchased, and I get the error: “This Connection Is Not Private. This website may be impersonating to steal your personal or financial information.” What used to be a legendary app is now barely known because the developers wanted too much money. Instead of a one-time purchase, you decided to charge absurd subscription fees just to use the equalizer, because nobody needs your buggy and inconvenient cloud service. The only thing that could save your project is offering full functionality with a one-time purchase, while keeping the cloud optional. And if you truly care so much about Ukraine, you could make the app completely free for the Ukrainian App Store during these difficult times for Ukrainians. People would support you with donations anyway. Otherwise, your project is doomed to bankruptcy.

reviews.title: Does not keep track of progress in a song
reviews.text: I tried to listen to some mp3 audiobook files either this app.  The tracks are often long- 25 minutes or more.  If I pause it mid track, then come back to it some time later, it restarts the track at 00:00.  Am I missing something?  That’s a deal-breaker for me.

reviews.title: Not fit for purpose on iPhone / iPad
reviews.text: The importing is cumbersome and simply doesn’t work unless you ‘share’ at most two or three tracks at a time. Try to share a folder or more tracks than a few and it collapses, just won’t do it. Says it’s copying the tracks then they don’t appear in the library. Not worth the risk to subscribe for full functionality. Why are we having to faff about with importing using the share function in any case?!

reviews.title: Album Art
reviews.text:
All library missing due to Server 500 error. Please help!           

                                                     I contacted  support last night. The team replaced my missing artwork today. Impressive turnaround. Thank you. You have a killer app with a good price, I look forward to it’s growing success.

reviews.title: Casualty of war
reviews.text: I subscribed to the service but didn’t realize their servers are in Ukraine. Big mistake. Degraded capabilities and no tech support. Hopefully my subscription will go to the war effort.

reviews.title: They just collect money. Months later and the same bugs.
reviews.text: I’ve been having a lot of issues syncing with Vox cloud. I canceled and deleted the app almost a year ago, came back and i’m still having issues. I went as far as deleting everything but it’s still not loading music properly. I have to sit in my car waiting for the app to go through zero byte music before it actually plays a song. And that’s if it doesn’t time out and stop all together. Now i have to look at my phone and hit shuffle again for it to continue to go through zero byte music. It’s very frustrating!

reviews.title: Crazy app, absolutely randomly written by AI
reviews.text: It does play music but adding it to the right place in the UI takes a long time! You drag n drop a file in there and never know where it appears inside this labyrinth of an app. When you re in the car the music is never where you expect it. Like why I can’t just add my track to the album? How do I sort songs by my order, they’re always alphabetical with no other options. Where does it take album background from, it’s always random. When I open the app where are Collections? You can add a song from library to collection but where is it? When you magically get to collection how to add songs to it? Why on Earth, just why it displays same art of songs accidentally have same album name? Why when I add songs to collections I can’t see collection names because there’s Play Next list on top that cannot be cleared. This software was written by AI.

reviews.text: this is the worst app i ever downloaded- it cannot open a single file on my iphone - the whole reason i downloaded it. it wants you to use a cloud, bad design. most important design feature would be opening a local file.
